correctness.rationale: A descendant collision between different coalitions of size ≤2 requires the two opposite diagonals of a rectangle: when one coordinate is constant the other coordinate set determines the coalition. Hence the graph is C4-free. Pair nonrepetition bounds the six neighborhood sizes by sum_i binom(d_i,2)≤15; balancing at total 17 already gives 16. At total 16 there are only three profiles meeting the bound. Five triples covering every pair are impossible by parity of the five pairs through a point, and a 4-block forces both triples to repeat the pair outside it. For the remaining profile (3,3,3,3,2,2), the four points outside the leave {a,b} each belong to exactly one 2-block by parity and the two 2-blocks exhaust these incidences. The 2-block matching and the two matchings induced by triples through a and b must be the three distinct matchings of K4. The stated Fano completion and representative follow. The 15·3·2·6!=64800 count labels these data without overcounting; there is already one side-preserving orbit and the full-group stabilizer is 16. Independent pair-mask backtracking checked all degree profiles, found 90 unordered block families with labeled points and verified all their Fano completions. Direct labeled orbit generation with an unsorted transpose verified the full group action (python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 4). The frozen script's helper sorts transpose rows; the analytic proof and the independent unsorted check verify the labeled transpose action without relying on that implementation detail.
